# Template catalog

Generated links to single canonical sources. Tool-native locations stay intact.

Whole-source entries include their embedded forms; frequent sections are linked directly below.

| Template or embedded form | Use when |
|---|---|
| [Pull request](../../.github/pull_request_template.md) | Every PR; complete applicable required sections with concrete evidence |
| [Discovery / feature / design](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/discovery.yml) | Explore a problem or decision, including a product with no PRD yet |
| [Bug report](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/bug_report.yml) | Report expected/actual behavior and reproduction |
| [Stage / engineering implementation](../../.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/stage_guardrail.yml) | Deliver accepted bounded scope with validation and closeout |
| [Work record and conditional design](../work/templates/WORK.md) | Preserve independently owned plan, decisions, evidence and handoff |
| [Work registry format](../work/templates/registry.schema.json) | Register work identities and exact source bindings; this is a schema, not a prose form |
| [New-project engineering playbook](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md) | Bootstrap and tailor engineering rules for a new project |
| [Adversarial invariant matrix](ADVERSARIAL_INVARIANT_MATRIX.md) | Plan positive/negative evidence for a governed slice |
| [Intent discovery](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md#gate-0-intent-discovery) | Define user, problem, outcome and unknowns before implementation |
| [Specification](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md#gate-1-specification) | Turn an accepted outcome into scoped, testable requirements |
| [Architecture review](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md#gate-5-architecture-review) | Review significant technical choices and alternatives |
| [Invariant-to-test matrix and pre-implementation evidence](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md#invariant-to-test-matrix-template) | Map each requirement and failure to verifiable evidence |
| [Closeout](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md#gate-8-proactive-next-step-closeout) | Use the existing completion and closeout requirements |
| [Source facts](NEW_PROJECT_ENGINEERING_PLAYBOOK.md#gate-2-source-facts) | Establish technical and external facts before choosing an implementation |
| [Human verification checklist](../../.github/pull_request_template.md#human-verification-checklist) | Make reviewer checks self-contained with sources and pass/fail criteria |
| [NarraTwin invariant mapping worked example](../ENGINEERING_PROCESS_RCA.md#invariant-to-test-matrix-template) | Consult repository-specific examples; use the engineering playbook for the reusable scaffold |
